item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)

expect.asks_about: Which of the two attached pictures should be upscaled?

item.title: Resolve the Upscale Target
item.tests: Asks which attachment the user means, then upscales only the selected picture without guessing or processing both.

answer_sheet.Framing: Keep the whole lake picture and its original proportions.

must_haves: The final deliverable is an upscaled version of lake-small.jpg, following clarification.
The lake, mountains, trees, clouds, and their arrangement remain faithful to the selected source.
The delivered image has larger pixel dimensions than lake-small.jpg, not merely a renamed copy.
The full original framing and aspect ratio are preserved.
Only one edited image is delivered; the dog photo is not included or blended into it.

turns.text: Could you upscale it for me, please? I've been meaning to get around to this for a while. I've attached this dog pic and this lake pic here. I'd appreciate your help with the upscaling.

dialog.agent: Would you like me to upscale **both the dog and lake photos**, or just one? Your free plan supports **2× upscaling**, keeping each photo’s original proportions.
dialog.why: It asks the user to choose whether to upscale both photos or just one, and waits for that choice.
dialog.user: Just the lake one, lake-small.jpg, please. Keep the whole lake picture and its original proportions, with no added text. I'll leave the output size and enhancement style up to you.

turns.agent:
I couldn’t upscale the lake photo because your Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. No image was created.

The selected settings were **2× upscaling with detail-preserving enhancement**, keeping the full picture and original proportions, with no added text. You can retry once credits are available.
